Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir

Blossom goes up against Morbucks for President.

Find out how amazing your hands are in today's lab when the doctors go head to head in a thumb challenge, and discover how drones are helping emergency rescue crews reach patients fast in Investigation Ouch.

The agents bring someone with an odd problem back to headquarters.

Lucia's spell goes wrong. Fernie designs a float.

Redbeard the Elf Pirate sets sail to find the lost city, but soon finds himself in trouble and in need of rescuing.
Gabriel and Penelope face-off in Full Disclosure and go to extreme lengths to dig for dirt. Ade and Ede learn that it's risky to trust a crook.
Are You Afraid of the Dark?
With her friends' lives at stake, Rachel decides to take charge and end Mr. Tophat's reign of terror. Will this story have a happy ending. or is the Midnight Society doomed?

The woolly mammoth and sabre tooth cat are brought back to life as we learn how these mighty beasts survived such savage environmental extremes and reveal why they could not survive when the ice began to thaw.

The MythBusters build a pressure cannon to see if a ping pong ball impact could be fatal. They also test the affect of water pressure on a deep sea diver, and find out if firehose pressure is enough to lift a car.
The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
This time The Slow Mo Guys go Medieval and look at the amazing world of Cannons. How far can Cannons fire?

The huge axe of Robot Thor driven by Jason, a builder from Northampton, clashes with Will and Ian from Team Shockwave. Judge Sethu Vijayakumar discusses his work with NASA in creating androids for the Mission to Mars.
A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number

We meet Australia's Portrait Artist of the Year, 18-year-old Jasmine Lancaster-Merton. We find out what it was like winning the competition and how she juggles Year 12 with her passion for portraits.
As May prepares for her second contest, Ash faces her rival Drew in a pre-contest battle.
The Start of Vengeance! The Frieza Force's Malice Strikes Gohan!

Without any way to get a hold of Goku or Vegeta, only Gohan and the remaining Z fighters are ready to face Frieza. Up against 1000 troops and the emperor of evil, our heroes may face more of a challenge than expected!
Ice Bear goes on a late-night adventure to rescue his friend, Yana.
Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir

Bubbles adopts a baby monster in the park.
When the girls tell Barry he's a hero, he takes it too far.

When Gary, the school's lollipop man, is accused of stealing bags from parents' cars, Kyle is devastated and determined to clear his name.

Jewels wants to win. Lucia gifts a new shawl.

Daniel can't wait to show Juan Carlos the Clock Factory, but remembers to ask Juan Carlos what he wants to do first. Daniel is a good host and they make a stop at the Music Shop for Juan Carlos and his mom.
While visiting Mr. Moon's shop with Granny, Maddie finds it difficult to choose what type of ice cream to get - there are just so many different flavours to choose from!
The Wise Old Elf fears an alien invasion after a presumed shooting star lands in the Little Kingdom.

The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks.
A Solo Peanut, a Social Butterfly and the Truth

Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
Babies, Lies and a Resplendent Cannoli
While Sheldon copes with the death of a hero, Georgie struggles with his big secret and Missy wants to babysit.
